scenes.say: Twenty years old, second season in Formula One, and already world champion.
Kimi Antonelli is the youngest champion ever. Vettel's record had stood since twenty ten.
He sealed it in Mexico City: third place was enough, the gap could no longer be closed.
And at Monza he started nineteenth and still won.
He's Italy's first champion since Alberto Ascari, seventy-three years ago.
A week later in Brazil, Mercedes wrapped up the constructors' title too.
Every champion's stats are on LapRadar.

title: Antonelli: world champion at 20
caption: The youngest champion in F1 history, Italy's first since Ascari, and the constructors' title for Mercedes. Stats: lapradar.com
